Class InvitationsController

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.admin.InvitationsController
@RestController public class InvitationsController extends Object
POST /invitations with {"email": "...", "roles": ["..."]} invites the address through InvitationService.invite(String, Set) and answers 201 with a CreatedInvitation; roles may be left out for none. The invitation stands when the link is not sent: linkSent is false.

It needs WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_MANAGE and, from a browser session, a recent sign-in, checked as every admin endpoint checks them (see AdminGate), before the body is read. Then a body that is not that JSON, a missing or malformed address and a role that does not exist are 400; a role carrying a permission the caller does not hold is 403 (see RoleGrants); and an address that is already an identity's is 409, as is one a concurrent invite of the same address took first. Anything else InvitationService.invite(String, Set) throws, such as an exception from the application's IdentityInvited listener, is answered with the exception's own @ResponseStatus, else 500. Nothing is created in any of these cases.
